season: Individuals in Germany are taxed between 14 and 42 percent for taxable income ranging from 11,600 and 66,700 euros. The tax rate is 42 percent up for until 277,000 euros and then is 45 percent for more than that. For an unmarried player with no children, a net salary of 60,000 euros needs a gross salary of 133,500 euros, according to the German league. A net salary of 120,000 euros costs a club a gross salary of 244,500 euros.
